block.condition.model.title: If
block.condition.model.description: Route each message to true or false from explicit conditions.
block.condition.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.condition.help_combinator: all: every condition must match. any: at least one condition must match.
block.condition.help_path: path: names separated by dots, with [index] for arrays, e.g. customer.email or items[0].price. Leave empty for the whole message. A path that does not resolve is missing, not an error.
block.condition.help_value: value: JSON such as 100, true, null, ["FR","BE"] or "quoted text"; anything else is plain text. Ignored by exists, not_exists, is_empty, is_not_empty, is_true and is_false.
block.condition.help_value_type: value_type: auto keeps JSON types (a number against numeric text compares as numbers); string, number, boolean and datetime convert both sides. case_sensitive applies to text.
block.condition.help_parse_json: auto parses text that is valid JSON and keeps other text; always requires JSON; never compares the raw text.
block.condition.help_on_error: fail stops the activation without publishing when a condition cannot be evaluated; no_match counts that condition as false and logs a warning.
block.condition.help_sample: Evaluated like a text message with the settings being edited, including unapplied changes. Nothing is saved, sent or run.
block.condition.card_invalid: Invalid settings: open the block to fix them.
block.condition.fix_errors: Not applied: fix the highlighted settings first.
block.condition.preview_invalid: Fix the highlighted settings to test them.
block.condition.preview_failed: The activation would fail and publish nothing (on_error fail).
block.condition.preview_branch: The message would be routed to {branch}.
block.condition.preview_warnings: Conditions in error count as false (on_error no_match).
block.condition.err_config_type: The settings must be a JSON object.
block.condition.err_combinator_invalid: combinator must be all or any.
block.condition.err_parse_json_invalid: parse_json must be auto, always or never.
block.condition.err_on_error_invalid: on_error must be fail or no_match.
block.condition.err_conditions_type: conditions must be a list of condition objects.
block.condition.err_condition_type: Each condition must be an object.
block.condition.err_path_invalid: path is not valid: separate names with dots and use [index] brackets, for example items[0].price.
block.condition.err_path_spaces: A name in path starts or ends with a space.
block.condition.err_value_type_invalid: value_type must be auto, string, number, boolean or datetime.
block.condition.err_case_sensitive_type: case_sensitive must be true or false.
block.condition.err_value_not_json: The value must be finite JSON.
block.condition.err_value_text_type: The value must be text in the editor.
block.condition.err_list_type: {operator} needs a JSON array of values, for example ["FR","BE"].
block.condition.err_list_too_long: The list has more than {max} items.
block.condition.err_pattern_type: matches_regex needs a non-empty text pattern; wrap it in double quotes if it looks like JSON.
block.condition.err_pattern_too_long: The pattern is longer than {max} characters.
block.condition.err_pattern_invalid: The pattern is not a valid regular expression: {detail}.
block.condition.err_value_not_numeric_au: {operator} with value_type auto compares numbers: enter a number, or choose value_type datetime to compare dates.
block.condition.err_value_not_number: The value must be a finite number for value_type number.
block.condition.err_value_not_boolean: The value must be true/false, yes/no or 1/0 for value_type boolean.
block.condition.err_value_not_datetime: The value must be an ISO 8601 date or date-time for value_type datetime.
block.condition.err_message_not_json: the message is not valid JSON and parse_json is always.
block.condition.err_message_not_text: the message is not text or JSON.
block.condition.err_not_number: the value is not a finite number.
block.condition.err_not_boolean: the value is not true/false, yes/no or 1/0.
block.condition.err_not_datetime: the value is not an ISO 8601 date or date-time.
block.condition.err_not_numeric_auto: the value is not numeric; choose value_type datetime to compare dates.
block.condition.err_subject_too_long: the text is longer than {max} characters.
block.condition.err_too_deep: the value is too deeply nested to compare.
block.condition.err_sample_too_large: The sample is longer than {max} characters.
